prompts.name: Fix Grammar
prompts.prompt: Correct all spelling, grammar and punctuation mistakes in the text. Keep the original wording, tone and language as much as possible and do not add new information. Return only the corrected text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Fixes spelling, grammar and punctuation without changing your wording.

prompts.name: Improve Writing
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text so it reads more clearly and flows better, while keeping its meaning, tone and language. Do not add new information. Return only the improved text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Rewrites for clarity and flow while keeping your meaning.

prompts.name: Simplify
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text in plain, simple language that anyone can understand. Keep the meaning and language, avoid jargon and long sentences, and add no new information. Return only the simplified text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Turns complex text into plain, easy-to-read language.

prompts.name: Remove Filler Words
prompts.prompt: Remove filler words, false starts and repetitions (such as "um", "uh", "like", "you know") from the dictated text without changing the wording or meaning of what remains. Keep the original language. Return only the cleaned-up text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Cleans up ums, uhs and repetitions from dictated speech.

prompts.name: Make Formal
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text in a polite, professional and formal tone. Keep its meaning and language and add no new information. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Rewrites your text in a professional, formal tone.

prompts.name: Make Friendly
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text in a warm, friendly and casual tone. Keep its meaning and language and add no new information. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Warms up your text with a friendly, casual tone.

prompts.name: Make Confident
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text so it sounds more confident and assertive, removing hedging and unnecessary apologies. Keep its meaning, language and core content. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Removes hedging so your message sounds self-assured.

prompts.name: Make Diplomatic
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text so it sounds more polite, tactful and diplomatic, softening anything that could come across as harsh, while keeping the message, meaning and language. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Softens a blunt message into a tactful, diplomatic one.

prompts.name: Make Shorter
prompts.prompt: Make the text noticeably shorter and more concise while keeping all important information, its tone and its language. Return only the shortened text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Trims your text down while keeping what matters.

prompts.name: Elaborate
prompts.prompt: Expand the text with more detail and explanation so it is clearer and more complete, while keeping its meaning, tone and language and without inventing facts. Return only the expanded text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Fleshes out a short note into a fuller message.

prompts.name: To Bullet Points
prompts.prompt: Reformat the text as a clear, concise bulleted list, grouping related points together. Keep the original meaning and language and add no new information. Return only the bulleted list, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Turns a paragraph into a tidy bulleted list.

prompts.name: Turn Into Email
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text as a well-structured, polite email with a suitable greeting and sign-off. Keep the core message, meaning and language, and do not invent names or facts. Return only the email, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Shapes rough notes into a polite, ready-to-send email.

prompts.name: Summarize
prompts.prompt: Summarize the text in one or two clear sentences that capture the key points. Keep the original language and add no new information. Return only the summary, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Condenses the selection into a one or two sentence gist.

prompts.name: Translate to English
prompts.prompt: Translate the text into natural, fluent English. Keep the original meaning and tone. Return only the translation, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Translates the selected text into natural English.

prompts.name: Translate to Spanish
prompts.prompt: Translate the text into natural, fluent Spanish. Keep the original meaning and tone. Return only the translation, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Translates the selected text into natural Spanish.

prompts.name: Add Emojis
prompts.prompt: Add a few fitting emojis to the text to make it more expressive, without changing the words, meaning or language. Do not overdo it. Return only the text with emojis, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Sprinkles a few fitting emojis into your text.

prompts.name: Inspiring Quote
prompts.prompt: Generate a single short, original and inspiring quote. Return only the quote itself, without an author, quotation marks or any explanation.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Generates a fresh short motivational quote.

prompts.name: Extract To-Dos
prompts.prompt: Turn the text into a clear checklist of actionable to-do items, one per line, each starting with '- '. Keep the original language. Return only the checklist, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Turns notes into an actionable checklist.

prompts.name: Draft a Reply
prompts.prompt: Write a concise, appropriate reply to the message in the text, matching its language and tone. Do not invent specific facts. Return only the reply, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Drafts a fitting reply to a message.

prompts.name: Define
prompts.prompt: Give a short, clear definition of the selected word or phrase in its language, in one or two sentences. Return only the definition, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Defines the selected word or phrase.

prompts.name: Explain Code
prompts.prompt: Explain what the selected code does in plain language, briefly and clearly. Keep it concise. Return only the explanation, without quotation marks.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Explains the selected code in plain words.

prompts.name: Commit Message
prompts.prompt: Write a concise git commit message in imperative mood summarizing the change described in the text. Return only the commit message, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Writes a commit message for the described change.

prompts.name: Add Hashtags
prompts.prompt: Append a short line of 3-5 relevant, popular hashtags below the text, keeping the original text unchanged and matching its language. Return only the text followed by the hashtags, without explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Adds a few fitting hashtags under your text.

prompts.name: Make a Post
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text as an engaging short social media post in the same language, keeping its meaning. Return only the post, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: DictateKeyboard
prompts.description: Turns your text into a catchy social post.

prompts.name: Yshai style
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text in the voice of a quiet teacher writing to a student. All lowercase, including the start of sentences. Short simple sentences in plain everyday words. Warm and humble, never grand. Short paragraphs of one to three sentences with a blank line between them. No bullet points, no headings, no dashes or em dashes. Keep the length close to the original and keep the writer's own meaning; say less rather than more. Keep the original language. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Lowercase, warm, unhurried. The voice of a teacher writing to a student.

prompts.name: Condense
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text so it says the same thing in fewer words. Remove repetition, filler and any word that carries no meaning. Merge sentences that make the same point. You may reorder sentences freely if a different order communicates more clearly. Lose no fact, no nuance and no intent. Keep the original language and the writer's tone. Return only the condensed text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Same meaning, fewer words. Repetition gone, order free to change.

prompts.name: In a nutshell
prompts.prompt: Read the whole text and return what actually matters in it: the takeaways and the principles behind them, not the details or the examples. Ignore digressions, repetitions and thinking out loud. Write a short piece of prose, no more than a third the length of the original, in the original language. If the text contains decisions or actions, state them plainly. Return only that summary, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: The takeaways and principles, with the blabbing left out.

prompts.name: Business
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text as clear professional business communication. Direct, courteous, no filler, no flattery, no exclamation marks. Lead with the point, then the detail. Keep the original language and every fact. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Direct and professional, point first.

prompts.name: Casual
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text the way you would say it to a colleague you like. Relaxed, natural, contractions welcome, no stiffness and no corporate wording. Keep the meaning and the original language. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Relaxed and natural, the way you would actually say it.

prompts.name: Friendly
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text so it sounds open and kind without becoming sweet or exaggerated. Keep every fact, soften anything that reads as blunt, and keep the original language. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Open and kind, without going sugary.

prompts.name: Warm
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text with real warmth, as if writing to someone you care about. Unhurried, personal, gentle in its wording, but never sentimental and never longer than it needs to be. Keep the meaning and the original language. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Personal and gentle, for people you care about.

prompts.name: Fun
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text with a light touch and a sense of play. Keep it quick, let the humour come from rhythm and word choice rather than jokes bolted on, and never let the joke cost the meaning. Keep the original language. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Light and playful, without losing the point.

prompts.name: Spiritual
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text in a contemplative voice: unhurried, grounded, attentive to what is underneath the words. Plain language rather than mystical vocabulary, and no preaching. Keep the writer's meaning and the original language. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Contemplative and grounded, no preaching.

prompts.name: Technical
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text as precise technical writing. Exact terms, unambiguous sentences, no marketing language and no hedging. Preserve every number, name and detail exactly. State assumptions where the original is vague rather than inventing facts. Keep the original language. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Precise and unambiguous, every detail preserved.

prompts.name: Musical
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the text with attention to its rhythm: vary sentence lengths, let it breathe, place the strongest word where the ear expects it, and use silence by keeping some sentences very short. Meaning first, music second, never the other way round. Keep the original language. Return only the rewritten text, without quotation marks or explanations.
prompts.author: Mantra Productions
prompts.description: Written for the ear, with rhythm and breath.
